name: Demo Flight
location_str: ADD Offshore launch platform @ Sea Launch, ???
destination_explanation: This orbit cleans up after itself. Dead satellites in the lowest orbits are pulled down by drag and burn up within a few years.
slot_a_text: First orbital full version launch of the South Korean military small satellite launch vehicle, after 2 sub-orbital tests of individual stages on 30 March and 30 December 2022, and 1 orbital test flight without the 2nd stage on 4 December 2023. Details TBD.
slot_b_text: This is the first launch from ADD Offshore launch platform this year.
lg_slot_a_text: First orbital full version launch of the South Korean military small satellite launch vehicle, after 2 sub-orbital tests of individual stages on 30 March and 30 December 2022, and 1 orbital test flight without the 2nd stage on 4 December 2023. Details TBD.
lg_slot_b_text: The T-0 is unconfirmed. It has already slipped twelve times. It last moved 6 days ago. There is a 4-hour window to work with.
lg_slot_c_text: Agency for Defense Development's 1st launch of the year, 2nd all time. It is the 257th orbital launch attempt worldwide this year.
